purpose: Maps nLDT components onto the LDT CitiVERSE EDIC Reference Architecture vocabulary (business services, application services, conformance profiles, standards), so the EDIC handover (nldt/21) and DTAS module passports (nldt/23) speak the EDIC's own language. Curated by hand against the extracted snapshot; a status only claims what an artifact evidences. Refresh procedure: rerun scripts/extract_edic_ra.py --commit latest, review drift, update statuses here.

Standards-based APIs.evidence: OGC API Records (:8083) and OGC API Processes (:8082) are the default public interfaces — exactly the RA's design-time contract list; OGC API Features/Tiles consumed via adapters

Metadata publication and discovery.evidence: catalog_adapter (OGC API Records) with application/recipe records; DCAT-AP DONL harvest (nldt/18)

Identity and access management.evidence: Keycloak realm LDT, bearer middleware on services + MCP, agent client registry (nldt/16 W6a)

Open interoperability interfaces.evidence: MCP servers (:8090-8093) and A2A (:8085) alongside the OGC APIs; JSON Schema contracts per service

Conformance to the architectural guardra.evidence: RA guardrails not yet published as a checkable list; nLDT validation V0-V4 covers outcomes (nldt/07)

Participation in federated discovery mec.evidence: Marketplace publish exists (mock); live EU LDT Toolbox Marketplace registration is DT-1 (nldt/23)

Descriptive LDT.evidence: Catalog, lake, viewers and dashboards exist; live sensor integration and event detection absent (sources arrive as files/archives)

Diagnostic LDT.evidence: Rule knowledge graph + decision tables explain *why* a zone is allowed (PoC-1); no generic Knowledge Graph Services or event processing

Predictive LDT.evidence: Time-series ingest + CDC replay enable historical analysis; no forecasting or ML models

Prospective LDT.evidence: Scenario Management, What-if Analysis and Model Composition implemented with provenance and controls: Utrecht scenario sweep, Breda indicator variants + rank-stability, Rijnland peil what-if, cross-track wind x zon x bos composition

Prescriptive LDT.evidence: No recommendation/optimisation services — deliberate: the doctrine keeps recommendation with the human (AI proposes, humans decide)

Autonomous LDT.evidence: Policy Enforcement (trustPolicy) and Human Oversight Services (HITL interrupts) match the profile's building blocks; adaptive learning and closed-loop actuation absent
